cohort_freeze_before_weather.catalogs_and_dated_metadata: snapshot originals, physical identity aliases, coordinates, sensor AGL and local-ground reference; strict dated 2m
cohort_freeze_before_weather.source_product_operator: AT nominal-node inference retained; DE TT_10 HH:00; CH six nominal samples with 5/12 and 7/12 linear model surrogate since 2018
cohort_freeze_before_weather.excluded_targets: all previous target identities, known station-error fits/scores and any prior raw target container exposure, including unused variables/years; disclose coarse-product exposure separately
cohort_freeze_before_weather.relative_elevation_strata: Within each country's metadata-admitted, exposure-admitted candidate pool, sort nominal site altitude then station key; split with numpy.array_split into 3 rank strata. These are relative ranks, not physical climate-zone classes.
cohort_freeze_before_weather.target_order_within_stratum: ascending SHA256 UTF8('IGE_V2_2019|' + station_key + '|20261027'), then station_key
cohort_freeze_before_weather.donor_selection: After the full target list is frozen, same-country physical identities in ascending nominal distance/key order; first 8 AT or 4 DE/CH candidates, then first 3 metadata-admitted, min 2; no replacements after weather acquisition
cohort_freeze_before_weather.insufficient_candidates_or_donors: retain SOURCE_BLOCKED and do not start unblinding; revise metadata-only protocol in a new version before weather, or report the blocked design

AT_new_primary_product_reconstruction.label: AUTOMATIC_CHECKED_ORIGINALITY_UNKNOWN_PROVIDER_PRODUCT
AT_new_primary_product_reconstruction.other_native_flags: retain counts and missing predictions; do not pool 11,12,20,21,22 with QC10 or replace the primary after scoring

QC_strata.AT_certified_original_substudy: requires a separately preregistered original-status source and product-specific temporal definition; old V1 QC22 stays blocked
QC_strata.DE: TT_10 native QN3, separate from standard-hourly QN10
QC_strata.CH: published historical OGD with no native per-row QC; separate from AT/DE

estimators.B0: same fixed Open-Meteo ERA5-derived background at target, elevation=nan, cell_selection=nearest, same time operator as R1; no native ERA5-orography claim
estimators.R1: unchanged frozen A1 IDW2 donor residual estimator; min 2 accepted donors per hour; raw missing values and candidate bounds retained
estimators.G1_or_fitted_lapse_or_covariance_rule: not a registered estimator in this design; any calibration/selection implementation requires a separate version and untouched evaluation cohort

applicability_diagnostics_not_accuracy_g: horizontal distances, interpolation vs extrapolation geometry
reported target and donor altitude ranges and model-site height proxies with datum/native-orography uncertainty
unique returned background cells and distinct temperature arrays; do not count shared cells as independent information
weights, effective weight count 1/sum(w^2), missingness and per-code counts; weight count is not independent sample size
leave-one-donor-out only when 3 donors allow the unchanged min-2 estimator; never replace with a one-donor rule
bias, centred error, RMSE and hourly endpoint diagnostics separately from reference-operator MAE
donor coherence or successful donor LOO does not imply target skill

scoring.primary: paired MAE_R1 minus MAE_B0 at the same accepted reference hours, first per station/season and country/QC stratum
scoring.country_pilot_benefit_rule: all 24 country cases >=160 pairs, country paired delta_MAE<0 and each of the 6 station paired delta_MAE<=0; otherwise no within-pilot uniform-benefit claim
scoring.zero_margin_meaning: conservative observed-score decision rule, not an equivalence test, significance result, confidence guarantee or proof of no harm
scoring.country_temporal_blocks: 4 synchronous week blocks across all 6 sites; keep all sites together and disclose shared-cell/donor dependencies
scoring.resampling: if displayed: 10000 PCG64 seed 20261027 draws of the 4 synchronous week blocks, descriptive percentiles only; no p<0.05 or population CI claim
scoring.CH_endpoint_test: not included in primary 12096 hours; register exact raw t assets, inverse/spinup/eligibility and additional bytes before any endpoint request if added
scoring.missing_R1: no hidden B0 fill in R1 accuracy; paired and all-reference B0 reported. Any B0 fallback product is a different named strategy with separate whole-request metrics.

pre_unblinding_required: complete exact catalog/admission/exposure/cohort JSON and source URL/member manifest, or retained blocks
freeze executable code, QC and scoring; publish exact registration SHA before predictor weather
acquire originals within registered attempts/time/byte budgets; no selection by weather availability or errors
publish actual predictions/NaNs, all 72 cases, weights, code/source hashes and source-based control admission before control bodies
separate runtime data-access holdout from upstream spatial QC and reanalysis assimilation dependence
if any prior exposure discovered: retain and downgrade to revealed, no post-error replacement

planned_compute_budget.bound_caveat: 45s socket timeout is not a total deadline; concrete executor must enforce per-attempt elapsed deadline and global wall/byte/request limits before this bound is asserted
planned_compute_budget.if_budget_insufficient: retain block or new metadata-only design version before measurement; never expand silently

qualification.code_correctness: offline source/seal regression and adversarial math tests
qualification.physical_admissibility: dated 2m and nominal time support only; full EPW physics and true instrument filters separate
qualification.independent_accuracy: new error holdout relative to method fitting with bounded exposure audit; provider QC and reanalysis assimilation dependence disclosed
qualification.operation: R1 stays research-only and non-default; actual EnergyPlus, full-year input completeness, multiyear historical reference and production separately
